utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the repair drive. What’s needed first?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thank you, Leo. First we just need to sort what’s broken and who can take which repair.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can do a quick check of the broken stuff and make a list. Then we can match each repair to whoever’s free.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m a little worried about the logistics—when are we collecting the repair items, and where should people drop them off?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Do we have a confirmed pickup time and drop-off spot yet?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Not yet, and I’d rather not guess. I think we should confirm both before people start bringing things over.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. I might've missed the latest on it; what's changed?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, hey Noah — I think the big thing is we’re still collecting repair items, and a few folks dropped off extra tools yesterday. I’m a bit fuzzy on the details, but I can check and let you know!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Oren — that’d help. I probably missed the drop-off, so just let me know what else I should bring.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m going to spread the word about the repair drive and make sure folks know the plan.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Vik — I’ll mention it too when I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, I’ll keep letting people know and make sure the plan stays clear.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Gus, I’m a bit late—how’s the repair drive going?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: It’s going pretty well so far—folks have been dropping off tools and supplies. If you need anything, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Quinn — let’s keep it simple and follow a clear plan for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word and keep it easy for everyone. I’ll start inviting folks right away.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great, Quinn — thank you. Let’s check in tomorrow and make sure the plan is still on track.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Sam, what’s the next step for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Next step is to sort the items by what needs fixing first, then we can get them to the right repair folks.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I haven’t tracked the repair drive yet, but I can keep an eye on where it’s happening and let you know as soon as I know.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Opal — that’d be a huge help. I’ll keep checking in too so we can share the location as soon as it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can help out with the repair drive—what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s wonderful, Mara — we still need a few more volunteers to sort donations and help with the sign-in table. Could you take one of those?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can take the sign-in table and help sort donations if needed.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can bring the extra tape and a few gloves for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, that’ll help a lot. I’ll handle the rest and meet you there.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, I’ll see you there with the tape and gloves.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting a nice turnout—people are bringing tools, supplies, and a lot of good energy. I can keep you posted if anything new comes up.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That’s good to hear, Tess. Keep me posted if there’s anything I can help with.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Will do, Rey — I’ll let you know if they need another pair of hands or any specific supplies.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Sure — before I act, can you confirm the repair drive details and what you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes — the repair drive is this Saturday at the school lot, and I just need you to help spread the word and bring any donated items by 10.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it — I’ll spread the word and bring any donated items by 10 on Saturday. If there’s a list of what you still need, send it my way.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—what’s the quickest way I can help with the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Grab the flyer stack and take the east block first—we can cover the rest after lunch.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it—I’ll start on the east block with the flyer stack now.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll keep the repair drive plan moving and let folks know what’s next.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Vik — that’ll really help keep everyone in the loop. Let me know if you want me to spread the word too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll keep repeating the next steps, and I’d appreciate you spreading the word too.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, the repair drive. I’m a bit scattered today, but I’m in if you still need a hand.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Noah. I could use the help—maybe you could start by sorting the donations when you have a minute.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Glad to hear it. I might swing by and see if you need a hand with anything.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Rey — could you help sort donations and hand out tools at the drive? That’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Absolutely — I can sort the donations and hand out tools at the drive.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Opal—I'm keeping the repair drive organized and moving. What do you want me to help with first?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Let’s start with the supply drop-off spot and who’s covering the west end.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’ll set the supply drop-off spot at the community shed, and I can cover the west end myself unless you want to swap anyone in.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’d like to help, but I’m a bit worried about the timing and where everything’s going to be dropped off.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Totally fair — I’ll send you the drop-off spot and timing as soon as I have it, and I’ll make sure it’s easy to find.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, that would help a lot. Once you’ve got the spot and timing, I can see whether I can make it work.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So, the repair drive is still happening, right? I just want to make sure I’ve got that confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, it’s still on. I’m just checking the details before we do anything else.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — so it’s confirmed as still on, and you’re just sorting the details?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let’s keep it simple: I can help if we set a clear time and a short list of what needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: That sounds fair—I can be there late afternoon if that works, and I’ll bring a short list of the fixes I know about.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Late afternoon works for me. Send the list when you can, and we’ll go item by item.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard there’s a repair drive happening soon—still catching up on the details, though. If you’ve got the latest, I’d love to hear it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve heard it’s coming up soon, but I’m still waiting on the full list of what they need. I’ll let you know as soon as I hear more.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, that’d be great. I’m just trying to keep up, so I’ll wait for your update.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m happy to help, Mara; just remind me what you need me to bring.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Oren — could you bring your toolbox and a few screwdrivers? If you’ve got any spare tape or pliers, those would help too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: You got it—I’ll bring my toolbox, a few screwdrivers, and I’ll look for some tape and pliers too. If I forget anything, just wave me down!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule if that makes the repair drive easier. Just let me know the time window and I’ll work around it.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: That’d help a lot — we’re aiming for after school, around 4 to 6. I’ll send you the final time once it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect — after 4 works best for me, and I can adjust if anything shifts. Just send the final time and I’ll plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m happy to help, just remind me what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m hearing a few things are still left: sorting donations, checking the tool table, and making sure we’ve got enough volunteers. I can go ask around if you want.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Nell—that’d be a big help. Could you ask around for volunteers first, and I’ll sort the donations and tool table here?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got a running list of what we still need for the repair drive. If you tell me what’s already covered, I can fill in the gaps.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I’m a bit foggy on the list, but I know we’ve already covered some of the basics. Remind me what’s still missing, and I’ll help if I can.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m still missing a few key things: heavy-duty tape, screwdrivers, batteries, and a couple tarps. If you remember anything else already covered, I’ll cross it off.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’m free to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Leo — could you bring a hammer, a screwdriver, and a roll of duct tape?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I’ll bring those.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can help with the repair drive—what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Mara — we still need a few hands for sorting donations and a ride for the big items. If you’re free, I’d really appreciate your help.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can help sort the donations, and I can also give a ride for the big items if you still need one.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You’re still doing the repair drive this weekend, right?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yeah, I am — still on for this weekend. I’m lining up a few helpers and a drop-off spot now.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Good, I just wanted to make sure. What time are you starting?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Tess—what’s the plan for the repair drive, and what do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ll gather folks, list the repair jobs, and set a time for the drive. If you can help spread the word and bring any tools you’ve got, that’d be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, right—how’s the repair drive going so far? I can keep an eye out for folks dropping things off while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Ira — that would be really helpful. I’ve got the drop-off spot by the side gate, and I’m keeping a list of what comes in.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help a little, but I need to keep it low-key today.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: No worries — low-key is fine. Even a small help on the repair drive would be great.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can swing by for a bit and help where I can, just nothing too public. Let me know what needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule—what time are you thinking for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Faye. I’m thinking Saturday morning would be best—maybe around 9?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday morning at 9 could work for me—I'll check the school schedule and get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll help spread the word about the repair drive and keep folks posted on the plan.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Vik — that really helps. I’ll send you the latest plan, and we can keep everyone in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — send me the latest plan, and I’ll keep repeating it to folks.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Do we need to bring tools, or are we just showing up to help?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Just showing up is perfect, but if you’ve got gloves or a basic tool kit, bring them along!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — I’ll bring gloves and a small toolkit.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but I’d like to know the timing and where we’re dropping things off first.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m usually the late one, but I can still help once I know the drop-off spot and when you’re going.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That works for me—if you tell me the drop-off spot and a rough time, I can plan around it.
